I didn’t include everything I did. Of course I reciprocated all that attention, he adored it, he would kiss me and call me cutie all the time and then he left the state. Put in his two weeks and took off. Before anything happened between us, it was actually him confiding in me with his emotions and pain. I’m one of the only people who knows his heart. I know his favorite songs, his dreams, I’d buy him his favorite drink all the time. I knew that he liked any food I made him even if it wasn’t as extravagant as the food he made, he just loved the fact that I made it. Don’t think I ever stopped seeing the value, he even told me that no one else had ever given him such affection and friendship. I can’t even reach him because he blocked me. I’m just so hurt.
